_comment: Manifest of third-party repos cloned into repos/. The repos/ directory is gitignored (shallow clones, ~565 MB) - this file is the source of truth so the setup can be reproduced. Recreate with: git clone --depth 1 <url> repos/<dir>

repos.skills: 5 SKILL.md in skills/ (hindsight-architect, hindsight-cloud, hindsight-docs, hindsight-local, hindsight-self-hosted)
repos.description: Vectorize's Hindsight long-term agent memory system (Python/Go monorepo: API, control plane, CLI, MCP server, clients, deploy artifacts) using retain-recall-reflect with observations, mental models, and memory banks; claims SOTA on LongMemEval.

repos.skills: 1 logical skill (skill/SKILL.src.md) compiled into 20 SKILL.md copies across .claude/, .cursor/, .gemini/, .opencode/, plugin/skills/; plus 24 slash commands, 4 agents, 40+ reference docs, 61 detector rules
repos.description: CLI + multi-agent plugin distribution (Rust core, Bun CLI, browser and VS Code extensions) giving AI coding agents frontend design guidance, live browser iteration, and 61 deterministic rules for detecting AI-generated design.

repos.skills: 31 SKILL.md across plugins/ and external_plugins/ (lsp, code-review, security, feature-dev, skill-creator, hookify, ...), plus many commands/ and agents/ definitions
repos.description: The official Claude Code plugin marketplace directory, bundling Anthropic-maintained plugins and third-party external plugins installable via /plugin install.

repos.skills: 7 SKILL.md under .claude/skills/ (ui-ux-pro-max, design, design-system, brand, ui-styling, slides, banner-design), mirrored in cli/assets/skills/; plus skill.json and a Claude plugin manifest
repos.description: Design-intelligence skill plus Python/TypeScript CLIs that search a curated database of UI styles, color palettes, font pairings, UX guidelines, chart types, and reasoning rules to generate tailored design systems for 22 tech stacks.

repos.skills: 8 SKILL.md in skills/ (context-mode, ctx-doctor, ctx-index, ctx-insight, ctx-purge, ctx-search, ctx-stats, ctx-upgrade)
repos.description: TypeScript/Bun MCP server (plus Claude/Codex/Cursor/OpenClaw plugin manifests) that keeps raw tool output out of the agent context window via sandboxed code execution and an FTS5/BM25-indexed SQLite session store that survives compaction.

repos.skills: 19 SKILL.md in skills/ + 1 in template/; the repo is entirely skills
repos.description: Anthropic's official repo of example Agent Skills for Claude, covering creative, technical, enterprise, and document (docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx) tasks, plus the Agent Skills spec and a skill template.

repos.skills: 13 SKILL.md in skills/ (taste-skill, taste-skill-v1, gpt-tasteskill, image-to-code, redesign, soft, output, minimalist, brutalist, stitch, imagegen-frontend-web/mobile, brandkit)
repos.description: Collection of anti-AI-slop frontend design Agent Skills encoding design-language inference, GSAP motion skeletons, redesign audits, and distinct visual directions (minimalist, brutalist, image-generation-only brand kits); installable via npx skills add or as a Claude plugin.

repos.skills: 95 SKILL.md in skills/ (one per Workspace API area) plus more in .agent/skills; README advertises 40+ agent skills
repos.description: gws, a Rust/Node CLI for Google Workspace that reads Google's Discovery Service at runtime to dynamically generate its whole command surface for Drive, Gmail, Calendar and more, emitting structured JSON.

repos.skills: 1 root SKILL.md + 1 in skills/manim-video/, backed by helpers/ Python editing scripts and install.md
repos.description: Conversation-driven video editing skill that turns a folder of raw footage into a graded, subtitled, audio-crossfaded final.mp4 via ffmpeg, ElevenLabs transcription, and parallel sub-agent animation generation, self-evaluating the render.

Karpathy's minimal single-GPU LLM pretraining playground (prepare.py + train.py, a simplified nanochat) where an AI agent autonomously edits train.py and runs fixed 5-minute experiments scored by val_bpb, with humans steering via program.md.

SkillUI, a Node CLI that statically crawls a website, git repo, or local codebase and extracts its full design system (colors, typography, spacing, animations, components, screenshots) into a .skill folder, with no AI or API keys required.

repos.skills: 1 root SKILL.md; the repo is essentially just the skill plus agents/openai.yaml and scripts/validate-package.py
repos.description: Pure-Markdown Agent Skill that rewrites AI-sounding text to read as human-written without altering its meaning, optionally matching a user-supplied voice sample; installable via npx skills add or as a Claude Code plugin.
